<abstract>Background The occurrence of abdominal aortic calcification (AAC) is associated with inflammation. This study aims to explore the relationship between the aggregate index of systemic inflammation (AISI) and AAC. Conclusion Our study highlights that AISI is correlated with both AAC and SAAC. However, extensive prospective studies are required to validate our results.</abstract>
</record>
